plan: Given my value of $22, I should bid slightly less than my value to maximize profit while still having a chance to win. A rational bidder will bid below their value to ensure a positive profit. Assuming others do the same, I will bid $21.9 to slightly undercut potential bids near their values. This maximizes my profit if I win and minimizes loss if I don't.

Given my value of $15, I should bid slightly below it to maximize profit while still having a chance to win. Since all bidders are rational, they will bid close to their values. Bidding $14.9 allows me to potentially win if others bid below their values or if their values are lower. This strategy balances the risk of losing with the potential profit if I win.

Given my value of $10, I should bid less than this to ensure a positive profit if I win. A rational strategy is to bid slightly under my value to outbid others while ensuring profit. Assuming others bid close to their values, I will bid $9.9 to maximize profit while maintaining competitiveness.
